nodes.description: LINE-1 retrotransposons act detrimentally to centromere integrity but also prevent centromeres from swelling indefinitely.

nodes.label: Epigenetic regulation
nodes.description: Epigenetic regulation of L1Hs retrotransposition plays crucial roles during early development.

nodes.label: Exon-acquisition
nodes.description: L1HS integration contributed to exon-acquisition in CHRM3.

nodes.label: Gene conversion
nodes.description: L1Hs elements may have originated via gene conversion.

nodes.label: gene expression regulation
nodes.description: Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in gene expression regulation.

nodes.label: gene transcription
nodes.description: L1HS mobility can affect gene transcription.

nodes.label: genome
nodes.description: A somatic L1HS insertion was identified in the aged prefrontal cortex.

nodes.label: genome integrity
nodes.description: Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in genome integrity.

nodes.label: genomic mosaicism
nodes.description: L1Hs activity in neural progenitor cells participates in creating genomic mosaicism.

nodes.label: Human-specific regulatory sequence creation
nodes.description: L1HS sequences harbor candidate human-specific regulatory loci.

nodes.label: Insertional mutagenesis
nodes.description: LINE-1 retrotransposition mediates insertional mutagenesis in cancer.

nodes.label: Insertional mutation
nodes.description: The L1HS element insertion causes a pathogenic mutation.

nodes.label: intrachromosomal recombination
nodes.description: Intrachromosomal recombination, through distant L1s, leads to deletion of L1s and surrounding alphoid sequences.

nodes.label: L1Hs antisense promoter (ASP) activity
nodes.description: L1Hs contains an antisense promoter in its 5'UTR that drives transcription.

nodes.label: L1Hs retrotransposition
nodes.description: L1Hs mediates its own retrotransposition process.

nodes.label: L1Hs transcription
nodes.description: L1Hs expresses its own transcription from an internal promoter in the 5'UTR.

nodes.label: LINE-1 retrotransposition
nodes.description: L1Hs elements undergo retrotransposition.

nodes.label: Mendelian inheritance
nodes.description: Non-reference LINE-1 polymorphic loci exhibit Mendelian inheritance patterns.

nodes.label: CDH11
nodes.description: CDH11 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.

nodes.label: CHRM3
nodes.description: L1HS integrated into the CHRM3 gene.

nodes.label: Genes associated with neural functions and disease
nodes.displayLabel: Genes associated with neural functions and disease
nodes.description: L1Hs elements integrate preferentially into genes associated with neural functions and diseases.

nodes.label: ODZ3
nodes.description: ODZ3 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.

nodes.label: PCM1
nodes.description: PCM1 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.

nodes.label: PTPRM
nodes.description: PTPRM was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.

nodes.label: ROBO2
nodes.description: ROBO2 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.

nodes.label: apurinic repair endonuclease
nodes.description: The second open reading frame of L1Hs encodes a nuclease related to apurinic repair endonucleases, which provides the enzyme activity for transposition.

nodes.label: beta-galactosidase
nodes.description: L1Hs promoter activity was monitored with a beta-galactosidase assay.

nodes.label: L1ORF1p
nodes.description: L1Hs transcription leads to ORF1p protein detection.

nodes.label: L1ORF2p
nodes.description: L1Hs transcripts encode ORF2p reverse transcriptase.

nodes.label: MeCP2
nodes.description: Somatic L1Hs insertions can occur in exons, including those of long genes like MECP2.

nodes.label: L1Hs transcript
nodes.description: L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active, producing RNA transcripts.

nodes.label: L1Hs-encoded transcript
nodes.description: L1Hs hypomethylation in NTDs was associated with increased expression of an L1Hs-encoded transcript.

nodes.label: T1 transcript
nodes.description: L1HS promoter drives expression of the T1 transcript.

events.message:
以下是当前图谱中 L1HS 的全部已连接关系：

### Disease
- Cancer [BIO_RELATION] L1HS mobilization in somatic tissues contributes to diseases such as cancer.
- Carcinoma [BIO_RELATION] Some LINE-1 loci can escape DNA methylation and become active, particularly in carcinomas.
- Colorectal cancer [BIO_RELATION] Certain colorectal cancers were excessively mutagenized by human-specific L1s.
- Disturbed spermatogenesis [BIO_RELATION] Hypomethylation in L1HS was detected in disturbed spermatogenesis.
- Genetic disease [BIO_RELATION] L1HS activity has the potential to cause disease.
- Genetic disease [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs retrotransposition occasionally leads to human genetic disorders.
- Lung cancer [BIO_RELATION] Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters in circulating DNA of lung cancer patients is more pronounced for the human-specific L1Hs family.
- Lung squamous cell carcinoma [BIO_RELATION] LSQCC exhibited the highest total levels of L1HS expression.
- Neural tube defect [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs hypomethylation in neuronal tissues is associated with NTD pathogenesis.
- Non-small cell lung cancer [BIO_RELATION] Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters was assessed in circulating DNA of non-small cell lung cancer patients.
- Schizophrenia [BIO_RELATION] L1HS transpositions are implicated as a genomic risk factor for schizophrenia.
- Systemic lupus erythematosu [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active in SLE neutrophils.

### Function
- Aging [BIO_RELATION] Relative cfDNA loss at the 5'UTR of L1HS retrotransposons was detected with age.
- Alternative splicing [BIO_RELATION] L1HS integration contributed to alternative splicing of CHRM3.
- centromere evolution [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs retrotransposons actively participate in the evolution of human centromeric alphoid sequences.
- centromere function [BIO_RELATION] Accumulation of LINE-1 insertions within a centromere-competent alphoid domain ruins centromere-forming competence.
- centromere integrity [BIO_RELATION] LINE-1 retrotransposons act detrimentally to centromere integrity but also prevent centromeres from swelling indefinitely.
- Epigenetic regulation [BIO_RELATION] Epigenetic regulation of L1Hs retrotransposition plays crucial roles during early development.
- Exon-acquisition [BIO_RELATION] L1HS integration contributed to exon-acquisition in CHRM3.
- Gene conversion [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs elements may have originated via gene conversion.
- gene expression regulation [BIO_RELATION] Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in gene expression regulation.
- gene transcription [BIO_RELATION] L1HS mobility can affect gene transcription.
- genome [BIO_RELATION] A somatic L1HS insertion was identified in the aged prefrontal cortex.
- genome integrity [BIO_RELATION] Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in genome integrity.
- genomic mosaicism [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs amplifies its copy in neural progenitor cells, causing genomic mosaicism.
- genomic mosaicism [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs activity in neural progenitor cells participates in creating genomic mosaicism.
- Human-specific regulatory sequence creation [BIO_RELATION] L1HS sequences harbor candidate human-specific regulatory loci.
- Insertional mutagenesis [BIO_RELATION] LINE-1 retrotransposition mediates insertional mutagenesis in cancer.
- Insertional mutation [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs insertions contribute to inter- and intra-individual genetic variation.
- Insertional mutation [BIO_RELATION] The L1HS element insertion causes a pathogenic mutation.
- intrachromosomal recombination [BIO_RELATION] Intrachromosomal recombination, through distant L1s, leads to deletion of L1s and surrounding alphoid sequences.
- L1Hs antisense promoter (ASP) activity [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs contains an antisense promoter in its 5'UTR that drives transcription.
- L1Hs retrotransposition [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs mediates its own retrotransposition process.
- L1Hs transcription [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs expresses its own transcription from an internal promoter in the 5'UTR.
- LINE-1 retrotransposition [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs elements undergo retrotransposition.
- Mendelian inheritance [BIO_RELATION] Non-reference LINE-1 polymorphic loci exhibit Mendelian inheritance patterns.

### Gene
- CDH11 [BIO_RELATION] CDH11 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.
- CHRM3 [BIO_RELATION] L1HS provides a novel promoter for CHRM3.
- CHRM3 [BIO_RELATION] L1HS integrated into the CHRM3 gene.
- Genes associated with neural functions and disease [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs elements integrate preferentially into genes associated with neural functions and diseases.
- ODZ3 [BIO_RELATION] ODZ3 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.
- PCM1 [BIO_RELATION] PCM1 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.
- PTPRM [BIO_RELATION] PTPRM was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.
- ROBO2 [BIO_RELATION] ROBO2 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.

### Protein
- apurinic repair endonuclease [BIO_RELATION] The second open reading frame of L1Hs encodes a nuclease related to apurinic repair endonucleases, which provides the enzyme activity for transposition.
- beta-galactosidase [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs promoter activity was monitored with a beta-galactosidase assay.
- L1ORF1p [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs transcription leads to ORF1p protein detection.
- L1ORF2p [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs transcripts encode ORF2p reverse transcriptase.
- MeCP2 [BIO_RELATION] Somatic L1Hs insertions can occur in exons, including those of long genes like MECP2.

### RNA
- L1Hs transcript [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active, producing RNA transcripts.
- L1Hs-encoded transcript [BIO_RELATION] L1Hs hypomethylation in NTDs was associated with increased expression of an L1Hs-encoded transcript.
- T1 transcript [BIO_RELATION] L1HS promoter drives expression of the T1 transcript.
参考来源：PMID 25352549: euL1db: the European database of L1HS retrotransposon insertions in humans.; PMID 34425899: Unbiased proteomic mapping of the LINE-1 promoter using CRISPR Cas9.; PMID 36449162: Genome-Wide Young L1 Methylation Profiling by bs-ATLAS-seq.

简要总结：
L1HS是人类特异性LINE-1逆转录转座子（PMID 25352549），其体细胞动员是癌症（尤其是结直肠癌）的重要驱动因素。关键证据来自结直肠肿瘤的全基因组分析，发现肿瘤中发生了广泛且过量的体细胞L1逆转录转座事件（PMID 22968929）。

events.message: I am now synthesizing the resolved entities, 2 identified knowledge gaps, and 54 evidence items into a coherent answer. Tools used: Entity Resolver, Graph Plugin, Citation Resolver.

claims.text: Resolved the TE entity L1HS with 2 strict alias variants.
L1HS BIO_RELATION Cancer (L1HS mobilization in somatic tissues contributes to diseases such as cancer.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Carcinoma (Some LINE-1 loci can escape DNA methylation and become active, particularly in carcinomas.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Colorectal cancer (Certain colorectal cancers were excessively mutagenized by human-specific L1s.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Disturbed spermatogenesis (Hypomethylation in L1HS was detected in disturbed spermatogenesis.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genetic disease (L1HS activity has the potential to cause disease.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genetic disease (L1Hs retrotransposition occasionally leads to human genetic disorders.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Lung cancer (Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters in circulating DNA of lung cancer patients is more pronounced for the human-specific L1Hs family.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Lung squamous cell carcinoma (LSQCC exhibited the highest total levels of L1HS expression.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Neural tube defect (L1Hs hypomethylation in neuronal tissues is associated with NTD pathogenesis.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Non-small cell lung cancer (Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters was assessed in circulating DNA of non-small cell lung cancer patients.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Schizophrenia (L1HS transpositions are implicated as a genomic risk factor for schizophrenia.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Systemic lupus erythematosu (L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active in SLE neutrophils.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Aging (Relative cfDNA loss at the 5'UTR of L1HS retrotransposons was detected with age.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Alternative splicing (L1HS integration contributed to alternative splicing of CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere evolution (L1Hs retrotransposons actively participate in the evolution of human centromeric alphoid sequences.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere function (Accumulation of LINE-1 insertions within a centromere-competent alphoid domain ruins centromere-forming competence.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere integrity (LINE-1 retrotransposons act detrimentally to centromere integrity but also prevent centromeres from swelling indefinitely.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Epigenetic regulation (Epigenetic regulation of L1Hs retrotransposition plays crucial roles during early development.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Exon-acquisition (L1HS integration contributed to exon-acquisition in CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Gene conversion (L1Hs elements may have originated via gene conversion.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION gene expression regulation (Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in gene expression regulation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION gene transcription (L1HS mobility can affect gene transcription.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genome (A somatic L1HS insertion was identified in the aged prefrontal cortex.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genome integrity (Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in genome integrity.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genomic mosaicism (L1Hs amplifies its copy in neural progenitor cells, causing genomic mosaicism.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genomic mosaicism (L1Hs activity in neural progenitor cells participates in creating genomic mosaicism.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Human-specific regulatory sequence creation (L1HS sequences harbor candidate human-specific regulatory loci.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutagenesis (LINE-1 retrotransposition mediates insertional mutagenesis in cancer.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutation (L1Hs insertions contribute to inter- and intra-individual genetic variation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutation (The L1HS element insertion causes a pathogenic mutation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION intrachromosomal recombination (Intrachromosomal recombination, through distant L1s, leads to deletion of L1s and surrounding alphoid sequences.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs antisense promoter (ASP) activity (L1Hs contains an antisense promoter in its 5'UTR that drives transcription.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs retrotransposition (L1Hs mediates its own retrotransposition process.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs transcription (L1Hs expresses its own transcription from an internal promoter in the 5'UTR.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION LINE-1 retrotransposition (L1Hs elements undergo retrotransposition.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Mendelian inheritance (Non-reference LINE-1 polymorphic loci exhibit Mendelian inheritance patterns.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CDH11 (CDH11 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CHRM3 (L1HS provides a novel promoter for CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CHRM3 (L1HS integrated into the CHRM3 gene.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genes associated with neural functions and disease (L1Hs elements integrate preferentially into genes associated with neural functions and diseases.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION ODZ3 (ODZ3 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION PCM1 (PCM1 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION PTPRM (PTPRM was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION ROBO2 (ROBO2 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)

L1HS BIO_RELATION apurinic repair endonuclease (The second open reading frame of L1Hs encodes a nuclease related to apurinic repair endonucleases, which provides the enzyme activity for transposition.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION beta-galactosidase (L1Hs promoter activity was monitored with a beta-galactosidase assay.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1ORF1p (L1Hs transcription leads to ORF1p protein detection.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1ORF2p (L1Hs transcripts encode ORF2p reverse transcriptase.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION MeCP2 (Somatic L1Hs insertions can occur in exons, including those of long genes like MECP2.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs transcript (L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active, producing RNA transcripts.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs-encoded transcript (L1Hs hypomethylation in NTDs was associated with increased expression of an L1Hs-encoded transcript.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION T1 transcript (L1HS promoter drives expression of the T1 transcript.)

walk_steps.summary: Resolved the TE entity L1HS with 2 strict alias variants.
L1HS BIO_RELATION Cancer (L1HS mobilization in somatic tissues contributes to diseases such as cancer.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Carcinoma (Some LINE-1 loci can escape DNA methylation and become active, particularly in carcinomas.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Colorectal cancer (Certain colorectal cancers were excessively mutagenized by human-specific L1s.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Disturbed spermatogenesis (Hypomethylation in L1HS was detected in disturbed spermatogenesis.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genetic disease (L1HS activity has the potential to cause disease.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genetic disease (L1Hs retrotransposition occasionally leads to human genetic disorders.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Lung cancer (Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters in circulating DNA of lung cancer patients is more pronounced for the human-specific L1Hs family.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Lung squamous cell carcinoma (LSQCC exhibited the highest total levels of L1HS expression.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Neural tube defect (L1Hs hypomethylation in neuronal tissues is associated with NTD pathogenesis.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Non-small cell lung cancer (Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters was assessed in circulating DNA of non-small cell lung cancer patients.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Schizophrenia (L1HS transpositions are implicated as a genomic risk factor for schizophrenia.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Systemic lupus erythematosu (L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active in SLE neutrophils.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Aging (Relative cfDNA loss at the 5'UTR of L1HS retrotransposons was detected with age.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Alternative splicing (L1HS integration contributed to alternative splicing of CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere evolution (L1Hs retrotransposons actively participate in the evolution of human centromeric alphoid sequences.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere function (Accumulation of LINE-1 insertions within a centromere-competent alphoid domain ruins centromere-forming competence.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere integrity (LINE-1 retrotransposons act detrimentally to centromere integrity but also prevent centromeres from swelling indefinitely.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Epigenetic regulation (Epigenetic regulation of L1Hs retrotransposition plays crucial roles during early development.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Exon-acquisition (L1HS integration contributed to exon-acquisition in CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Gene conversion (L1Hs elements may have originated via gene conversion.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION gene expression regulation (Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in gene expression regulation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION gene transcription (L1HS mobility can affect gene transcription.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genome (A somatic L1HS insertion was identified in the aged prefrontal cortex.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genome integrity (Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in genome integrity.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genomic mosaicism (L1Hs amplifies its copy in neural progenitor cells, causing genomic mosaicism.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genomic mosaicism (L1Hs activity in neural progenitor cells participates in creating genomic mosaicism.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Human-specific regulatory sequence creation (L1HS sequences harbor candidate human-specific regulatory loci.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutagenesis (LINE-1 retrotransposition mediates insertional mutagenesis in cancer.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutation (L1Hs insertions contribute to inter- and intra-individual genetic variation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutation (The L1HS element insertion causes a pathogenic mutation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION intrachromosomal recombination (Intrachromosomal recombination, through distant L1s, leads to deletion of L1s and surrounding alphoid sequences.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs antisense promoter (ASP) activity (L1Hs contains an antisense promoter in its 5'UTR that drives transcription.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs retrotransposition (L1Hs mediates its own retrotransposition process.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs transcription (L1Hs expresses its own transcription from an internal promoter in the 5'UTR.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION LINE-1 retrotransposition (L1Hs elements undergo retrotransposition.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Mendelian inheritance (Non-reference LINE-1 polymorphic loci exhibit Mendelian inheritance patterns.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CDH11 (CDH11 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CHRM3 (L1HS provides a novel promoter for CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CHRM3 (L1HS integrated into the CHRM3 gene.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genes associated with neural functions and disease (L1Hs elements integrate preferentially into genes associated with neural functions and diseases.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION ODZ3 (ODZ3 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION PCM1 (PCM1 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION PTPRM (PTPRM was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION ROBO2 (ROBO2 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)

L1HS BIO_RELATION apurinic repair endonuclease (The second open reading frame of L1Hs encodes a nuclease related to apurinic repair endonucleases, which provides the enzyme activity for transposition.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION beta-galactosidase (L1Hs promoter activity was monitored with a beta-galactosidase assay.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1ORF1p (L1Hs transcription leads to ORF1p protein detection.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1ORF2p (L1Hs transcripts encode ORF2p reverse transcriptase.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION MeCP2 (Somatic L1Hs insertions can occur in exons, including those of long genes like MECP2.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs transcript (L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active, producing RNA transcripts.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs-encoded transcript (L1Hs hypomethylation in NTDs was associated with increased expression of an L1Hs-encoded transcript.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION T1 transcript (L1HS promoter drives expression of the T1 transcript.)

L1HS BIO_RELATION Cancer (L1HS mobilization in somatic tissues contributes to diseases such as cancer.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Carcinoma (Some LINE-1 loci can escape DNA methylation and become active, particularly in carcinomas.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Colorectal cancer (Certain colorectal cancers were excessively mutagenized by human-specific L1s.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Disturbed spermatogenesis (Hypomethylation in L1HS was detected in disturbed spermatogenesis.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genetic disease (L1HS activity has the potential to cause disease.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genetic disease (L1Hs retrotransposition occasionally leads to human genetic disorders.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Lung cancer (Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters in circulating DNA of lung cancer patients is more pronounced for the human-specific L1Hs family.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Lung squamous cell carcinoma (LSQCC exhibited the highest total levels of L1HS expression.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Neural tube defect (L1Hs hypomethylation in neuronal tissues is associated with NTD pathogenesis.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Non-small cell lung cancer (Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters was assessed in circulating DNA of non-small cell lung cancer patients.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Schizophrenia (L1HS transpositions are implicated as a genomic risk factor for schizophrenia.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Systemic lupus erythematosu (L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active in SLE neutrophils.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Aging (Relative cfDNA loss at the 5'UTR of L1HS retrotransposons was detected with age.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Alternative splicing (L1HS integration contributed to alternative splicing of CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere evolution (L1Hs retrotransposons actively participate in the evolution of human centromeric alphoid sequences.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere function (Accumulation of LINE-1 insertions within a centromere-competent alphoid domain ruins centromere-forming competence.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere integrity (LINE-1 retrotransposons act detrimentally to centromere integrity but also prevent centromeres from swelling indefinitely.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Epigenetic regulation (Epigenetic regulation of L1Hs retrotransposition plays crucial roles during early development.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Exon-acquisition (L1HS integration contributed to exon-acquisition in CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Gene conversion (L1Hs elements may have originated via gene conversion.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION gene expression regulation (Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in gene expression regulation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION gene transcription (L1HS mobility can affect gene transcription.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genome (A somatic L1HS insertion was identified in the aged prefrontal cortex.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genome integrity (Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in genome integrity.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genomic mosaicism (L1Hs amplifies its copy in neural progenitor cells, causing genomic mosaicism.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genomic mosaicism (L1Hs activity in neural progenitor cells participates in creating genomic mosaicism.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Human-specific regulatory sequence creation (L1HS sequences harbor candidate human-specific regulatory loci.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutagenesis (LINE-1 retrotransposition mediates insertional mutagenesis in cancer.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutation (L1Hs insertions contribute to inter- and intra-individual genetic variation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutation (The L1HS element insertion causes a pathogenic mutation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION intrachromosomal recombination (Intrachromosomal recombination, through distant L1s, leads to deletion of L1s and surrounding alphoid sequences.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs antisense promoter (ASP) activity (L1Hs contains an antisense promoter in its 5'UTR that drives transcription.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs retrotransposition (L1Hs mediates its own retrotransposition process.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs transcription (L1Hs expresses its own transcription from an internal promoter in the 5'UTR.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION LINE-1 retrotransposition (L1Hs elements undergo retrotransposition.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Mendelian inheritance (Non-reference LINE-1 polymorphic loci exhibit Mendelian inheritance patterns.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CDH11 (CDH11 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CHRM3 (L1HS provides a novel promoter for CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CHRM3 (L1HS integrated into the CHRM3 gene.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genes associated with neural functions and disease (L1Hs elements integrate preferentially into genes associated with neural functions and diseases.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION ODZ3 (ODZ3 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION PCM1 (PCM1 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION PTPRM (PTPRM was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION ROBO2 (ROBO2 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)

L1HS BIO_RELATION apurinic repair endonuclease (The second open reading frame of L1Hs encodes a nuclease related to apurinic repair endonucleases, which provides the enzyme activity for transposition.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION beta-galactosidase (L1Hs promoter activity was monitored with a beta-galactosidase assay.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1ORF1p (L1Hs transcription leads to ORF1p protein detection.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1ORF2p (L1Hs transcripts encode ORF2p reverse transcriptase.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION MeCP2 (Somatic L1Hs insertions can occur in exons, including those of long genes like MECP2.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs transcript (L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active, producing RNA transcripts.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs-encoded transcript (L1Hs hypomethylation in NTDs was associated with increased expression of an L1Hs-encoded transcript.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION T1 transcript (L1HS promoter drives expression of the T1 transcript.)

supported_claims: Resolved the TE entity L1HS with 2 strict alias variants.
L1HS BIO_RELATION Cancer (L1HS mobilization in somatic tissues contributes to diseases such as cancer.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Carcinoma (Some LINE-1 loci can escape DNA methylation and become active, particularly in carcinomas.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Colorectal cancer (Certain colorectal cancers were excessively mutagenized by human-specific L1s.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Disturbed spermatogenesis (Hypomethylation in L1HS was detected in disturbed spermatogenesis.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genetic disease (L1HS activity has the potential to cause disease.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genetic disease (L1Hs retrotransposition occasionally leads to human genetic disorders.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Lung cancer (Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters in circulating DNA of lung cancer patients is more pronounced for the human-specific L1Hs family.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Lung squamous cell carcinoma (LSQCC exhibited the highest total levels of L1HS expression.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Neural tube defect (L1Hs hypomethylation in neuronal tissues is associated with NTD pathogenesis.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Non-small cell lung cancer (Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters was assessed in circulating DNA of non-small cell lung cancer patients.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Schizophrenia (L1HS transpositions are implicated as a genomic risk factor for schizophrenia.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Systemic lupus erythematosu (L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active in SLE neutrophils.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Aging (Relative cfDNA loss at the 5'UTR of L1HS retrotransposons was detected with age.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Alternative splicing (L1HS integration contributed to alternative splicing of CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere evolution (L1Hs retrotransposons actively participate in the evolution of human centromeric alphoid sequences.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere function (Accumulation of LINE-1 insertions within a centromere-competent alphoid domain ruins centromere-forming competence.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere integrity (LINE-1 retrotransposons act detrimentally to centromere integrity but also prevent centromeres from swelling indefinitely.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Epigenetic regulation (Epigenetic regulation of L1Hs retrotransposition plays crucial roles during early development.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Exon-acquisition (L1HS integration contributed to exon-acquisition in CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Gene conversion (L1Hs elements may have originated via gene conversion.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION gene expression regulation (Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in gene expression regulation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION gene transcription (L1HS mobility can affect gene transcription.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genome (A somatic L1HS insertion was identified in the aged prefrontal cortex.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genome integrity (Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in genome integrity.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genomic mosaicism (L1Hs amplifies its copy in neural progenitor cells, causing genomic mosaicism.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genomic mosaicism (L1Hs activity in neural progenitor cells participates in creating genomic mosaicism.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Human-specific regulatory sequence creation (L1HS sequences harbor candidate human-specific regulatory loci.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutagenesis (LINE-1 retrotransposition mediates insertional mutagenesis in cancer.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutation (L1Hs insertions contribute to inter- and intra-individual genetic variation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutation (The L1HS element insertion causes a pathogenic mutation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION intrachromosomal recombination (Intrachromosomal recombination, through distant L1s, leads to deletion of L1s and surrounding alphoid sequences.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs antisense promoter (ASP) activity (L1Hs contains an antisense promoter in its 5'UTR that drives transcription.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs retrotransposition (L1Hs mediates its own retrotransposition process.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs transcription (L1Hs expresses its own transcription from an internal promoter in the 5'UTR.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION LINE-1 retrotransposition (L1Hs elements undergo retrotransposition.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Mendelian inheritance (Non-reference LINE-1 polymorphic loci exhibit Mendelian inheritance patterns.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CDH11 (CDH11 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CHRM3 (L1HS provides a novel promoter for CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CHRM3 (L1HS integrated into the CHRM3 gene.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genes associated with neural functions and disease (L1Hs elements integrate preferentially into genes associated with neural functions and diseases.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION ODZ3 (ODZ3 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION PCM1 (PCM1 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION PTPRM (PTPRM was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION ROBO2 (ROBO2 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)

L1HS BIO_RELATION apurinic repair endonuclease (The second open reading frame of L1Hs encodes a nuclease related to apurinic repair endonucleases, which provides the enzyme activity for transposition.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION beta-galactosidase (L1Hs promoter activity was monitored with a beta-galactosidase assay.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1ORF1p (L1Hs transcription leads to ORF1p protein detection.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1ORF2p (L1Hs transcripts encode ORF2p reverse transcriptase.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION MeCP2 (Somatic L1Hs insertions can occur in exons, including those of long genes like MECP2.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs transcript (L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active, producing RNA transcripts.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs-encoded transcript (L1Hs hypomethylation in NTDs was associated with increased expression of an L1Hs-encoded transcript.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION T1 transcript (L1HS promoter drives expression of the T1 transcript.)

walk_steps.summary: Resolved the TE entity L1HS with 2 strict alias variants.
L1HS BIO_RELATION Cancer (L1HS mobilization in somatic tissues contributes to diseases such as cancer.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Carcinoma (Some LINE-1 loci can escape DNA methylation and become active, particularly in carcinomas.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Colorectal cancer (Certain colorectal cancers were excessively mutagenized by human-specific L1s.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Disturbed spermatogenesis (Hypomethylation in L1HS was detected in disturbed spermatogenesis.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genetic disease (L1HS activity has the potential to cause disease.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genetic disease (L1Hs retrotransposition occasionally leads to human genetic disorders.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Lung cancer (Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters in circulating DNA of lung cancer patients is more pronounced for the human-specific L1Hs family.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Lung squamous cell carcinoma (LSQCC exhibited the highest total levels of L1HS expression.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Neural tube defect (L1Hs hypomethylation in neuronal tissues is associated with NTD pathogenesis.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Non-small cell lung cancer (Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters was assessed in circulating DNA of non-small cell lung cancer patients.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Schizophrenia (L1HS transpositions are implicated as a genomic risk factor for schizophrenia.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Systemic lupus erythematosu (L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active in SLE neutrophils.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Aging (Relative cfDNA loss at the 5'UTR of L1HS retrotransposons was detected with age.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Alternative splicing (L1HS integration contributed to alternative splicing of CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere evolution (L1Hs retrotransposons actively participate in the evolution of human centromeric alphoid sequences.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere function (Accumulation of LINE-1 insertions within a centromere-competent alphoid domain ruins centromere-forming competence.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere integrity (LINE-1 retrotransposons act detrimentally to centromere integrity but also prevent centromeres from swelling indefinitely.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Epigenetic regulation (Epigenetic regulation of L1Hs retrotransposition plays crucial roles during early development.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Exon-acquisition (L1HS integration contributed to exon-acquisition in CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Gene conversion (L1Hs elements may have originated via gene conversion.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION gene expression regulation (Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in gene expression regulation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION gene transcription (L1HS mobility can affect gene transcription.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genome (A somatic L1HS insertion was identified in the aged prefrontal cortex.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genome integrity (Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in genome integrity.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genomic mosaicism (L1Hs amplifies its copy in neural progenitor cells, causing genomic mosaicism.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genomic mosaicism (L1Hs activity in neural progenitor cells participates in creating genomic mosaicism.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Human-specific regulatory sequence creation (L1HS sequences harbor candidate human-specific regulatory loci.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutagenesis (LINE-1 retrotransposition mediates insertional mutagenesis in cancer.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutation (L1Hs insertions contribute to inter- and intra-individual genetic variation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutation (The L1HS element insertion causes a pathogenic mutation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION intrachromosomal recombination (Intrachromosomal recombination, through distant L1s, leads to deletion of L1s and surrounding alphoid sequences.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs antisense promoter (ASP) activity (L1Hs contains an antisense promoter in its 5'UTR that drives transcription.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs retrotransposition (L1Hs mediates its own retrotransposition process.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs transcription (L1Hs expresses its own transcription from an internal promoter in the 5'UTR.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION LINE-1 retrotransposition (L1Hs elements undergo retrotransposition.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Mendelian inheritance (Non-reference LINE-1 polymorphic loci exhibit Mendelian inheritance patterns.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CDH11 (CDH11 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CHRM3 (L1HS provides a novel promoter for CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CHRM3 (L1HS integrated into the CHRM3 gene.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genes associated with neural functions and disease (L1Hs elements integrate preferentially into genes associated with neural functions and diseases.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION ODZ3 (ODZ3 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION PCM1 (PCM1 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION PTPRM (PTPRM was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION ROBO2 (ROBO2 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)

L1HS BIO_RELATION L1ORF1p (L1Hs transcription leads to ORF1p protein detection.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1ORF2p (L1Hs transcripts encode ORF2p reverse transcriptase.)

supported_claims: Resolved the TE entity L1HS with 2 strict alias variants.
L1HS BIO_RELATION Cancer (L1HS mobilization in somatic tissues contributes to diseases such as cancer.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Carcinoma (Some LINE-1 loci can escape DNA methylation and become active, particularly in carcinomas.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Colorectal cancer (Certain colorectal cancers were excessively mutagenized by human-specific L1s.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Disturbed spermatogenesis (Hypomethylation in L1HS was detected in disturbed spermatogenesis.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genetic disease (L1HS activity has the potential to cause disease.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genetic disease (L1Hs retrotransposition occasionally leads to human genetic disorders.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Lung cancer (Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters in circulating DNA of lung cancer patients is more pronounced for the human-specific L1Hs family.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Lung squamous cell carcinoma (LSQCC exhibited the highest total levels of L1HS expression.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Neural tube defect (L1Hs hypomethylation in neuronal tissues is associated with NTD pathogenesis.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Non-small cell lung cancer (Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters was assessed in circulating DNA of non-small cell lung cancer patients.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Schizophrenia (L1HS transpositions are implicated as a genomic risk factor for schizophrenia.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Systemic lupus erythematosu (L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active in SLE neutrophils.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Aging (Relative cfDNA loss at the 5'UTR of L1HS retrotransposons was detected with age.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Alternative splicing (L1HS integration contributed to alternative splicing of CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere evolution (L1Hs retrotransposons actively participate in the evolution of human centromeric alphoid sequences.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere function (Accumulation of LINE-1 insertions within a centromere-competent alphoid domain ruins centromere-forming competence.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere integrity (LINE-1 retrotransposons act detrimentally to centromere integrity but also prevent centromeres from swelling indefinitely.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Epigenetic regulation (Epigenetic regulation of L1Hs retrotransposition plays crucial roles during early development.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Exon-acquisition (L1HS integration contributed to exon-acquisition in CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Gene conversion (L1Hs elements may have originated via gene conversion.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION gene expression regulation (Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in gene expression regulation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION gene transcription (L1HS mobility can affect gene transcription.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genome (A somatic L1HS insertion was identified in the aged prefrontal cortex.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genome integrity (Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in genome integrity.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genomic mosaicism (L1Hs amplifies its copy in neural progenitor cells, causing genomic mosaicism.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genomic mosaicism (L1Hs activity in neural progenitor cells participates in creating genomic mosaicism.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Human-specific regulatory sequence creation (L1HS sequences harbor candidate human-specific regulatory loci.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutagenesis (LINE-1 retrotransposition mediates insertional mutagenesis in cancer.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutation (L1Hs insertions contribute to inter- and intra-individual genetic variation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutation (The L1HS element insertion causes a pathogenic mutation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION intrachromosomal recombination (Intrachromosomal recombination, through distant L1s, leads to deletion of L1s and surrounding alphoid sequences.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs antisense promoter (ASP) activity (L1Hs contains an antisense promoter in its 5'UTR that drives transcription.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs retrotransposition (L1Hs mediates its own retrotransposition process.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs transcription (L1Hs expresses its own transcription from an internal promoter in the 5'UTR.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION LINE-1 retrotransposition (L1Hs elements undergo retrotransposition.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Mendelian inheritance (Non-reference LINE-1 polymorphic loci exhibit Mendelian inheritance patterns.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CDH11 (CDH11 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CHRM3 (L1HS provides a novel promoter for CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CHRM3 (L1HS integrated into the CHRM3 gene.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genes associated with neural functions and disease (L1Hs elements integrate preferentially into genes associated with neural functions and diseases.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION ODZ3 (ODZ3 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION PCM1 (PCM1 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION PTPRM (PTPRM was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION ROBO2 (ROBO2 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)

L1HS BIO_RELATION apurinic repair endonuclease (The second open reading frame of L1Hs encodes a nuclease related to apurinic repair endonucleases, which provides the enzyme activity for transposition.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION beta-galactosidase (L1Hs promoter activity was monitored with a beta-galactosidase assay.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1ORF1p (L1Hs transcription leads to ORF1p protein detection.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1ORF2p (L1Hs transcripts encode ORF2p reverse transcriptase.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION MeCP2 (Somatic L1Hs insertions can occur in exons, including those of long genes like MECP2.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs transcript (L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active, producing RNA transcripts.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs-encoded transcript (L1Hs hypomethylation in NTDs was associated with increased expression of an L1Hs-encoded transcript.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION T1 transcript (L1HS promoter drives expression of the T1 transcript.)

walk_steps.summary: Resolved the TE entity L1HS with 2 strict alias variants.
L1HS BIO_RELATION Cancer (L1HS mobilization in somatic tissues contributes to diseases such as cancer.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Carcinoma (Some LINE-1 loci can escape DNA methylation and become active, particularly in carcinomas.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Colorectal cancer (Certain colorectal cancers were excessively mutagenized by human-specific L1s.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Disturbed spermatogenesis (Hypomethylation in L1HS was detected in disturbed spermatogenesis.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genetic disease (L1HS activity has the potential to cause disease.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genetic disease (L1Hs retrotransposition occasionally leads to human genetic disorders.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Lung cancer (Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters in circulating DNA of lung cancer patients is more pronounced for the human-specific L1Hs family.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Lung squamous cell carcinoma (LSQCC exhibited the highest total levels of L1HS expression.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Neural tube defect (L1Hs hypomethylation in neuronal tissues is associated with NTD pathogenesis.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Non-small cell lung cancer (Hypomethylation of LINE-1 promoters was assessed in circulating DNA of non-small cell lung cancer patients.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Schizophrenia (L1HS transpositions are implicated as a genomic risk factor for schizophrenia.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Systemic lupus erythematosu (L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active in SLE neutrophils.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Aging (Relative cfDNA loss at the 5'UTR of L1HS retrotransposons was detected with age.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Alternative splicing (L1HS integration contributed to alternative splicing of CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere evolution (L1Hs retrotransposons actively participate in the evolution of human centromeric alphoid sequences.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere function (Accumulation of LINE-1 insertions within a centromere-competent alphoid domain ruins centromere-forming competence.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION centromere integrity (LINE-1 retrotransposons act detrimentally to centromere integrity but also prevent centromeres from swelling indefinitely.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Epigenetic regulation (Epigenetic regulation of L1Hs retrotransposition plays crucial roles during early development.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Exon-acquisition (L1HS integration contributed to exon-acquisition in CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Gene conversion (L1Hs elements may have originated via gene conversion.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION gene expression regulation (Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in gene expression regulation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION gene transcription (L1HS mobility can affect gene transcription.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genome (A somatic L1HS insertion was identified in the aged prefrontal cortex.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genome integrity (Polymorphic mobile element insertions are involved in genome integrity.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genomic mosaicism (L1Hs amplifies its copy in neural progenitor cells, causing genomic mosaicism.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION genomic mosaicism (L1Hs activity in neural progenitor cells participates in creating genomic mosaicism.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Human-specific regulatory sequence creation (L1HS sequences harbor candidate human-specific regulatory loci.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutagenesis (LINE-1 retrotransposition mediates insertional mutagenesis in cancer.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutation (L1Hs insertions contribute to inter- and intra-individual genetic variation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Insertional mutation (The L1HS element insertion causes a pathogenic mutation.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION intrachromosomal recombination (Intrachromosomal recombination, through distant L1s, leads to deletion of L1s and surrounding alphoid sequences.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs antisense promoter (ASP) activity (L1Hs contains an antisense promoter in its 5'UTR that drives transcription.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs retrotransposition (L1Hs mediates its own retrotransposition process.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs transcription (L1Hs expresses its own transcription from an internal promoter in the 5'UTR.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION LINE-1 retrotransposition (L1Hs elements undergo retrotransposition.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Mendelian inheritance (Non-reference LINE-1 polymorphic loci exhibit Mendelian inheritance patterns.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CDH11 (CDH11 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CHRM3 (L1HS provides a novel promoter for CHRM3.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION CHRM3 (L1HS integrated into the CHRM3 gene.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION Genes associated with neural functions and disease (L1Hs elements integrate preferentially into genes associated with neural functions and diseases.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION ODZ3 (ODZ3 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION PCM1 (PCM1 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION PTPRM (PTPRM was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION ROBO2 (ROBO2 was targeted by somatic LINE-1 insertions in colorectal tumors.)

L1HS BIO_RELATION apurinic repair endonuclease (The second open reading frame of L1Hs encodes a nuclease related to apurinic repair endonucleases, which provides the enzyme activity for transposition.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION beta-galactosidase (L1Hs promoter activity was monitored with a beta-galactosidase assay.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1ORF1p (L1Hs transcription leads to ORF1p protein detection.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1ORF2p (L1Hs transcripts encode ORF2p reverse transcriptase.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION MeCP2 (Somatic L1Hs insertions can occur in exons, including those of long genes like MECP2.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs transcript (L1Hs loci are transcriptionally active, producing RNA transcripts.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION L1Hs-encoded transcript (L1Hs hypomethylation in NTDs was associated with increased expression of an L1Hs-encoded transcript.)
L1HS BIO_RELATION T1 transcript (L1HS promoter drives expression of the T1 transcript.)
